name: ossuary
description: The Ossuary as Logan Wolf went through it, played by the user on 2026-10-28: two visits in capture 20261028_165135 (17:13:43-17:26:28 levels 1-3, 17:32:01-17:37:37 levels 1-2; pets GraveRobber and AlaFlambe) and one in 20261028_182147 (20:34:27-21:03:36 levels 1-4; AlaFlambe and Bussin); a fourth on 2026-10-31 in 20261031_170158 (20:37:19-21:13:33 levels 1-4, 20 min on level 3 and 10.5 on level 4; AlaFlambe and Bussin). The tome row 'Ossuary' lands outside at (1213, 2816); the entrance (1205, 2816-2817) takes one to level 1 at (5927, 1316). Levels by a map flood fill (pathfind.Walk from each arrival; all of Logan's steps there walk on the map): level 1 x 5785-5935, y 1270-1381 (9,259 tiles; 141 s there, walked through); level 2 x 5581-5689, y 1225-1363 (6,668; 915 s); level 3 x 5527-5739, y 950-1156 (11,364; 2,573 s), the hunting level by default; level 4 x 4825-5000, y 1744-2073 (21,141; 856 s), in another part of the map, by the strips at level 3's north end (5588-5590, 985) and north-west (5651-5654, 950). Merged at load time with ossuary_kb.json (wiki stats, sim/kb_scan.py, plus 5 hand entries) and ossuary_observed.json (sim/calibrate.py --scenario ossuary).

Captures: the user's three visits on 2026-10-28 and one on 2026-10-31 (description); the pets differ between them (GraveRobber + AlaFlambe, then AlaFlambe + Bussin), so damage_to_pets mixes their armor

spawn_note: one spawn per cluster of a type's first sightings in the visits (sim/calibrate.py's Session first sightings of creatures with notoriety 3-5; sightings of a type within 5 tiles merged, the earliest kept): level 1 40, level 2 52, level 3 107, level 4 15 from the 2026-10-28 visits; then 55 from 2026-10-31 (35 on level 3, 20 on level 4), only where the earlier visits couldn't see (a first sighting more than 18 tiles from every tile they stood on: 113 of the 184 sightings weren't), so a spawn already had isn't counted twice.
